literal: "We are subtle" those who say - measuring - rod - seeing - time - eye - other than - is not - other things.
translation: When you look for the measuring rod of those who say "we are sharp," it is nothing other than the eye.
modern: 'நாங்கள் நுண்ணறிவு உடையவர்கள்' என்று கூறுபவர்களின் அளவுகோலை ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால், அது மற்றவர்களின் கண்களைத் தவிர வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet reveals the secret tool of those who are skilled at reading minds. People who claim to have the subtle intelligence to understand unspoken thoughts rely entirely on observing others. When we look for their measuring rod, we find it is nothing other than the eyes of the people they interact with. The eyes serve as a precise instrument that measures and reveals a person's true inner feelings.
